the red cell membrane fluidity is not influenced by individual phospholipid composition of red cells in VAD patients, but in the group of subjects with VAD and NIDDM the individual phospholipide composition is altered and the erythrocytes membrane fluidity is unchanged.

in subjects with VAD and NIDDM the erythrocytes are characterized by a decrease of phosphatidyl choline and phosphatydylserine and by a decrease of the membrane fluidity; the decrease of phosphatidyserine is more marked in subjects with VAS and with NIDDM.

in subjects with VAD there is an increase in red cell membrane phosphatidyl serine, and in subjects with V AD and NIDDM an increase in phosphatidyl choline; the erythrocytes from subjects with VAD and NIDDM have a lower membrane fluidity than the erythrocytic membranes from subjects with V AD without NIDDM.
